captionBasis: Both Maryland forms extract clean text, and Maryland authored its AcroForm field names as the printed captions themselves. `printedCaptionFound` records, per field, whether that exact string was found in the printed text of the page the widget sits on; where it is false the printed line at the widget's own coordinate is recorded beside it. See reports/caption-evidence.json.
